**No School (Ex)** Instead of specializing in a focused arcane school of magic, a wizard can choose to specialize as a foreseen adept. Unlike a normal arcane school, this requires the wizard to select necromancy as his single opposition school. He does not need to select a second opposition school. He must expend two spell slots to prepare a spell from his opposed school as normal.

**Bonus Spells** A Foreseen Adept gains one additional spell slot of each wizard spell level he is able to cast (including level 0). He may only use these spell slots to prepare spells from the foreseen adept spell list:

**Foreseen Adept Spell List**

- **0-level:** arcane mark, resistance, detect magic, read magic
- **1st:** bungle, comprehend languages, identify, mirror strike, true strike
- **2nd:** arcane disruption, embrace destiny, haunting mists, knock, make whole, time shudder, twisted space, obscure object
- **3rd:** arcane sight, clairaudience/clairvoyance, explosive runes, haste, locate weakness, nondetection, pain strike, sands of time, slow, urban step
- **4th:** akashic communionMTT, detect scrying, dimensional anchor, lesser geas, hallucinatory terrain, nondetection (communal), remove curse, scrying, true form
- **5th:** analyze dweomer, contact other plane, dismissal, legend lore, life bubble, planar adaptation, mage’s private sanctum, trace teleport, greater track ship†
- **6th:** age resistance, antimagic field, break enchantment, contingency, disintegrate, globe of invulnerability, legend lore, mage's lucubration, planar binding, prognostication, true seeing
- **7th:** banishment, ethereal jaunt, age resistance (greater), arcane sight (greater), scrying (greater), sequester, insanity, create demiplane (lesser), limited wish, planar adaptation (mass), planar refuge, plane shift, teleport trap
- **8th:** create demiplane, discern location, dimensional lock, maze, moment of prescience, greater planar binding, protection from spells, rift of ruin
- **9th:** temporal stasis

This replaces arcane school and Scribe Scroll.
